body: Follow-up to bd-01M2EEVF9EPRH4DMTEVE2934YW. Continuous boundary-cell extension repairs C04 r23/r24 endpoint topology under unchanged interior gates, but r24 residual inverse whole-field maximum is 8.0862 mm and endpoint round-trip maxima are about 4.65/4.63 mm. notes.text: 2026-10-14: Reused as R02 in the new HalfFlow qualification epic bd-01M4X4DHZEPAVKJ7DE94ET3Z21. Existing body, historical evidence and parents are preserved. This remains the owner of the complete export-boundary inverse contract, including the original C04 boundary failure cases. Existing interior-only successes do not resolve it. G3 (bd-01M4X4DWZGYGS728AQ5R0G67Z4) requires a declared, verified full-boundary contract without hiding invalid samples or relaxing thresholds. No duplicate boundary implementation ticket was created.

Begin a separate untimed boundary-representation diagnosis while the existing 61-state anatomy batch continues from immutable inputs. Test whether an exact inverse sampled back to the same uniform grid and boundary-linear continuation can satisfy both full-boundary compositions for nonlinear monotone maps. Distinguish numerical-solver error from inverse-interpolation/extension error with analytic and exact piecewise-linear oracles. Preserve production sources and thresholds; no fit policy or qualification promotion. Reproduce the actual r24 failure if the saved or reconstructible fixture permits a bounded frozen-field probe.

Independent predeclared representation oracle completed: translation and affine controls invert to machine precision; monotone nonlinear map has exact pointwise inverse error <=1e-12mm but storing/extrapolating that inverse on original grid yields2.115384615mm round-trip error. Padding to contain forward nodal range plus one cell yields .012mm with identical25-point denominators and positive forward/inverse cell slopes. This proves a representation limitation, not actualr24 attribution or a production fix. Nine sampler/root/oracle checks pass. Current C04 diagnostic field capture runs after preserving three failed preparations (stale pre-provider runner hash; sandbox sbt lock; generated logger warning). Use current canonical adapter with explicit historical diff and require both r24 residual hashes to match before attribution. Separate two-arm/two-grid bounded root protocol frozen before capture outcomes; no source/threshold changes or qualification claim.

Completed actual C04 capture/root/witness/cell diagnosis, with all24 historical C4 forward/inverse field hashes replaying exactly. Existing central-difference checks report zero folds for all48 captured fields, but the unchanged nine-sample complete-cell evaluator finds folds in9/12 C4 forward residuals and3/12 C4 inverses; all24 current C5 fields pass. r24 C4 forward fixed/moving have12/33 folded cells, minimumJ -.222107/-1.556543 despite positive central minima .612304/.289369. All46656 cells per field retained with100% coverage. Smooth-cell follow-up confirms26/26 negative analytic/finite-difference Jacobians (22 probes in original grid,4 exterior), derivative disagreement <1.1e-9, resolving knot-derivative ambiguity. More accurate same-grid roots still have2.874598/3.345792mm opposite-composition maxima; moving has2 unresolved roots. Declared41^3 padding fails with130/127 unresolved roots, all original50653 target samples retained and invalids explicit. Numerical inverse refinement alone cannot repair these forward folds. Current C5 hashes do NOT replay historical C5, and all24 mismatches are retained; they are current controls only. No production source/threshold changes or MRI accuracy claim. Complete evidence c04-outcomes-v1; report halfflow-boundary-representation-v1.md and corrected historical topology interpretation. Next: enforce applicable complete-cell checks on authoritative forward states, then evaluate extension/branch and inverse methods on admitted states; R02 remains doing/open.

Implement default all-complete-cell Jacobian admission at eight corners and center on incremental and accumulated authoritative forward states, retaining existing voxel checks, Jacobian floors, controller and attempt budgets. Cover both HalfFlow-CC and BasinBridge through their shared ForwardGeometry gate. Add export checks for authoritative source and endpoint cells so direct API construction cannot bypass optimizer checks. Preserve frozen MRI studies and historical fields. Validate hidden boundary-cell folds, physical affine grids/handedness, masks/nonfinite support, native parity against all48 captured fields and a new six-case C04 replay with independent cell audits. Full inverse-boundary accuracy remains separately required; no claim of MRI improvement from stronger topology admission.

Implemented the shared full complete-cell corner/center gate for both incremental and accumulated forward arms, legacy pair guard, direct export source validation and copied endpoint-map admission. Existing Jacobian floors, inverse bounds and all trial budgets preserved. JVM 66/66 targeted geometry/export/CC/BasinBridge/algebra tests pass; JavaScript checks and runner compilation ongoing. The 12 mm translation now backtracks past two folded integration trials to alpha .25, retains about 9 mm match error, and is not called solved; compression preserves the original state after all four unsafe declared trials. Prospective 48-field native parity and corrected six-case C04 declarations are being prepared. R02 remains open for boundary inverse accuracy and acquired-data qualification.
